lesson: Today, we work on one technique repetition with a difference. That means a word or shape comes back later in the poem, but changed. Watch how this poem does it with cold. Early on the feet meet boards gone chill overnight. Then the cold climbs your ankles the way water does. Later the kettle returns. The kettle's cold and the day's still soft. Same cold three times, but each time it sits on a different thing. This works in a plain way. When a word returns, you remember the first time you hew it. So the second and third cold feel connected to the first. The repeat makes you track the word and feel the poem tighten. Try this, pick one plain word, use it early, then bring it back two more times on different objects. The second time through, follow the word cold from the boards to the kettle and let so up land.
